label: ercot73 state wall
definition: ERCOT-73 commitment-STATE conditioned cleared-share wall on the ERCOT-71 leg-A base (ercot66-storage-rebasis recipe + measured non-CAMPD per-plant availability). LEG CS = the ERCOT-72 measured DAM cleared-share offer boundary; LEG STATE = the ERCOT-73 measured commitment-loading state weight w = clip((online_cap - gross)/(online_cap - cleared), 0, 1) per class-hour (CAMPD CEMS envelope/gross x DAM awards; scripts/derive_ercot_commitment_loading_state.py, frozen rule 23, zero fitted scalars) — the wall prices the DA participation cliff only in proportion to the measured unloaded share of the above-DA online capability; RUC/self-commitment regimes stand it down (rules 13/14/26). Full-span 2023-2025 (rule 16). CANDIDATE (CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS; keeper decision is the owner's): 2024 C3a -7.1% -> -3.1% with C3b 0.160 -> 0.141; 2025 C3a -5.1% -> -1.8% with C3b 0.102 -> 0.088; May-24 shoulder composition holds the ERCOT-72 hit (CC corrected excess +675 -> -311 MW, share 0.872 -> 0.830, CT +215; the static form's ST_GAS overflow gone) with the shoulder price at $30.8 of $67.3 (formation partially open — wall mid-rungs + drag-owned steam); Aug 18-20 2024 guard holds (2h vs 4h > $200, no shed); cost: 2023 C3a +4.7% -> +6.2% (Jun +0.9 / Sep +1.0 residual lift, Aug toward actual — the 2023 summer over-shoot stays lane 2). C3c gated on the rubric v2.6 RT basis: 179/181 (0.99x) / 26/53 (0.49x, ledgered G-22) / 19/31 (0.61x).
market_story: CC_REGULAR/CT_PEAKER: ERCOT has no DAM must-offer — on moderate days a measured ~35% of CC (and ~50-80% of CT) live capability carries no DA offer at any price, so the real market serves shoulder demand from the belt-priced unloaded headroom of the committed fleet plus CTs and steamers at $57-100, not from cheap econ tranches; the cleared-share wall prices the model's capacity above the bin's measured DA position at the measured uncleared-offer ladder. The commitment-loading state weight carries the other regime: when reality RUC/self-commits that same capacity online and loads it to its envelope (tight periods — measured w -> 0 in Aug-23/Sep-23/Jan-24 tight hours), the capacity is inframarginal near cost and the wall stands down. Both regimes are measured series end to end (DAM disclosure cleared shares + offer ladders; CEMS online envelope/gross), zero fitted scalars. ST_GAS is deliberately NOT walled (drag-owned, rule 19): its measured DA participation cliff (live 5.9 GW, cleared 1.2 GW on the May-24 shoulders, offers p50 $27 with a steep cap tail) is the drag lane's recorded finding and the named owner of the remaining shoulder formation gap. Promotion record (owner, 2026-07-16 session): LOYO (rule 22) is satisfied structurally — no pooled or fitted quantity enters any backcast year (each year solves on its own measured state/boundary/ladder tables; the pooled climatology is a forward-only fallback, unused here), so a leave-one-year-out re-solve is provably byte-identical to the registered full-span run.
